findings.title: Exact reviewed-head evidence exceeds the unchanged 16 MiB aggregate cap
findings.description: Independent repository compact-evidence audit of protected base af09be228fbc89d074b6e863c83e1fdda343d55b versus reviewed head 900d667394599345a51cec851160d33c01ebce7f measures 18,099,028 bytes across 634 changed evidence/review blobs. This exceeds the inclusive 16,777,216-byte cap by 1,321,812 bytes. The audit has exactly one error: PR-evidence-total. The task RESULT honestly remains BLOCKED, despite sixteen individually passing checks at e81cc2ccff69bf32a42f7c81b4671c99879b544b. All required completion conditions are not satisfied, so neither review PASS nor a merge recommendation is justified. Review-record additions also count toward the cap and cannot waive this failure.
findings.required_change: Resolve capture/storage through separately reviewed prospective governance, retain lossless current executions and failure history, and produce a compliant task revision with fresh revision-bound verification and reviews as required by the result/review contracts. Do not truncate, rewrite history, waive the budget, or treat recorded check PASS as task/review PASS.
